name: @sync/fiber
description: Fiber reactivity: synchronous reads over asynchronous sources via Suspense.

scripts.bench: pnpm build && node bench/run.mjs && node --expose-gc bench/memory.mjs && node --expose-gc bench/async.mjs && node bench/compare.mjs && node bench/links.mjs && node --allow-natives-syntax bench/shapes.mjs && node --allow-natives-syntax bench/assert-opt.mjs && node bench/size.mjs
scripts.bench:deopt: pnpm build && node --trace-deopt bench/run.mjs 2>&1 | grep -iE "deoptimizing" | grep -icE "read|update|put|link" || true
scripts.bench:probe: pnpm build && node bench/probe.mjs && node bench/probe-async.mjs
